loadFailed.message: This could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

partialCountsHint: Approximate: the full window could not be read, counts are a lower bound

problemAnalysisPage.emptyHint: Try expanding the time range or adjusting filters
problemAnalysisPage.emptyTitle: No problem analysis data found for the selected period

problemResolution.allResolvedHint: Enable "Show resolved ({{total, number}})" above to review them
problemResolution.allResolvedTitle: All problems in this view are marked resolved
problemResolution.saveFailed: Could not update the resolved status. Try again.

picker.title: Choose a workspace
picker.intro: You are a member of more than one workspace. Choose the one to open.

notFound.title: Workspace not found
notFound.body: This workspace does not exist, or you are not a member of it. Open one of yours, or ask a workspace admin to add you.
notFound.none: You are not a member of any workspace yet.

unavailable.title: Could not load your workspaces
unavailable.body: Your workspaces could not be loaded, so this workspace cannot open. Check your connection and try again.

workspaces.sharedData: Each workspace keeps its own feedback, dashboards, brand, resolved problems, categories, dimensions and source policies, and the plugins its admins turn on collect feedback into it. Projects, the assistant, Radar and the other settings are still shared by every workspace.
workspaces.moreFailed: The next page could not be loaded. Choose Show more to try again.
workspaces.refreshFailed: The list could not be refreshed, so it may be out of date.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Who can open {{name}}, and their role in it.
members.readOnly: Only the workspace's admins can add members, change roles or remove members.
members.addHint: Someone who already has an account becomes a member at once. A new email first gets an account, with a temporary password sent by email; only a deployment administrator can do that.
members.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
members.addedExisting: {{email}} is now a member ({{role}}). No email was sent: let them know.
members.addedCreated: Created an account for {{email}} and added it ({{role}}). They get an email with a temporary password.
members.loadFailed: The members could not be loaded.
members.removeConfirm: Remove {{who}} from {{name}}? They will no longer be able to open this workspace.
members.demoteSelfConfirm: You will be {{role}} in {{name}} and may no longer manage its members. Another admin of this workspace, or a platform admin, can give it back.
members.leaveConfirm: You will no longer be able to open {{name}}. An admin of the workspace can add you again.

platform.title: Workspaces
platform.description: Every workspace of this deployment. Only platform admins see this list, create workspaces and enter any of them as an admin; entering one you are not an admin of is recorded in its audit log.
platform.name: Name
platform.slugHint: The workspace opens at /w/<slug>/, which cannot be changed later.
platform.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to {{max, number}} characters.
platform.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen, and not admin, api, app, platform or www.
platform.loadFailed: The workspaces could not be loaded.
platform.none: No workspaces yet. Create the first one above.

platformAdmins.title: Platform admins
platformAdmins.description: Platform admins create workspaces and can enter any of them as an admin. Only an administrator can be one, and one enabled platform admin always remains. A change reaches the person's session the next time it refreshes.
platformAdmins.label: Platform admin
platformAdmins.adminsOnly: Only an administrator can be a platform admin.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.subtitle: The brand, plugins, categories, dimensions and source policies of {{name}}.
settings.brandDescription: This workspace's own brand. A new workspace starts with an empty one: nothing is copied from the deployment's brand.
settings.brandReadOnly: Only this workspace's admins can change its brand. You can view it here.
settings.pluginsDescription: The plugins this deployment offers, and whether this workspace has turned each one on. A plugin turned on here runs on its schedule for this workspace, and Run now runs it here.
settings.pluginsReadOnly: Only this workspace's admins can turn plugins on or off.
settings.pluginsLoadFailed: The plugins could not be loaded.

export.title: Export
export.description: Download a copy of what this workspace holds: its feedback, configuration, members and audit history, as JSON files in one zip. A completed export can be downloaded for 7 days.
export.readOnly: Only this workspace's admins can export it.
export.loadFailed: The export's status could not be loaded.
export.runningNote: The export is being prepared. This section updates by itself; you can leave the page and come back.
export.completedNote: Ready since {{date}}. You can download it until {{until}}.
export.expiredNote: Its 7 days are over. Start a new export to download one.
export.erasedNote: An erasure reached this workspace, so this export was deleted. Start a new export.
export.failedNote: The export stopped before it finished. Start it again.
export.linkNote: Each download link works for 15 minutes.

config.categoriesDescription: This workspace's own categories classify its feedback. A new workspace has none: its feedback is classified with the built-in default categories until its admins add some. Nothing is copied from the deployment's categories.
config.dimensionsDescription: This workspace's own dimensions. A new workspace has only the built-in ones; nothing is copied from the deployment's.
config.sourcesDescription: How this workspace keeps the feedback of each source: PII handling, restricted sources, default dimension values and tags. A source without a profile here has its personal data redacted and is visible to every member, whatever the deployment's profiles say.
config.retentionDeployment: Retention windows are the deployment's: its window for this source also deletes this workspace's items, and a workspace profile cannot set one.
config.readOnly: Only this workspace's admins can change its categories, dimensions and source policies.
config.adminNotice: These are the deployment's own settings, not those of {{name}}: they classify and redact all feedback outside workspaces, and only the deployment's administrators can save them. The settings of {{name}} are on its Workspace settings page.

deploymentBrand.title: Deployment default brand
deploymentBrand.description: The deployment's own brand, used outside any workspace as before workspaces. Participant emails and feedback boards still use its name. Each workspace has a brand of its own: nothing is copied between them.
deploymentBrand.readOnly: Only the deployment's administrators can change the default brand. You can view it here.

errors.lastAdmin: A workspace needs an admin: make another member an admin first.
errors.changedMeanwhile: The membership changed meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
errors.alreadyMember: That person is already a member of this workspace.
errors.ambiguousEmail: More than one account has this email. Ask a platform admin to resolve it.
errors.emailElsewhere: An account already uses this email with different capitalization. Enter it as that account writes it.
errors.noLongerAdmin: You are no longer an admin of this workspace. Reload the page.
errors.newAccountAdminsOnly: This email has no account yet. Only a deployment administrator can create one while workspaces share their data.
errors.notWorkspaceAdmin: Only the workspace's admins can do that.
errors.memberGone: That person is no longer a member. Reload the page.
errors.workspaceGone: This workspace is not available any more.
errors.slugTaken: That address is taken: choose another slug.
errors.notPlatformAdmin: Only platform admins can do that. If you were one, your access may have been revoked.
errors.lastPlatformAdmin: This is the last enabled platform admin: make another administrator a platform admin first.
errors.grantNeedsAdmin: Only an administrator can be a platform admin: make the user an administrator first.
errors.userGone: That user no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.pluginGone: This deployment no longer offers that plugin. Reload the page.
errors.pluginsChangedMeanwhile: The workspace's plugins changed meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
errors.pluginNotEnabled: Enable this plugin for the workspace first: Workspace settings → Plugins.
errors.notDeploymentAdmin: Only the deployment's administrators can change the default brand.
errors.notBrandAdmin: Only this workspace's admins can change its brand.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
errors.exportRunning: An export of this workspace is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.exportErasureRunning: An erasure is running in this workspace. Start the export when it ends.
errors.exportNotDownloadable: This export can no longer be downloaded. Start a new export.

timeRange.label: Time range
timeRange.importedDescription: When the feedback was collected into the platform.
timeRange.importedTooltip: Filtering by when data was collected, not when the review was written.
timeRange.reviewDescription: When the customer originally wrote the feedback.
timeRange.reviewTooltip: Filtering by when the review was written, not when it was imported.
timeRange.customHint: Enter 1–{{max, number}} days. For every review, choose All time.
timeRange.customError: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {{max, number}}.

theme.colorThemeHint: Your own pick, kept in this browser. Workspace default follows the theme an administrator chose for everyone.

partialTimeBudgetHint: Approximate: to answer in time, counts cover {{date}} onward — narrow the window for a complete total

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Your profile, password, preferences and your own objectives & KPIs.
account.name: Name
account.mcpHint: Connect your external assistants with one MCP token for the whole app, minted on Connect.

password.title: Change Password
password.intro: Enter your current password and choose a new one
password.requirements: Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numbers
password.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

account.signOutHint: End your session on this device.
account.briefHint: Your own brief: when it arrives, in which language, what it focuses on, and whether it is emailed to you.
account.guideOpen: Show "How it works" expanded on Home

assistant.hint: How the AI assistant behaves for you in this browser.
assistant.notifyHint: When a conversation you are not looking at needs your approval, replies or fails. The same setting as the bell in the assistant header.
assistant.bubbleMoved: You moved the bubble. Reset puts it back in the bottom-right corner.
assistant.bubbleDefault: The bubble is in its default corner.

access.hint: What you can see in this app. An administrator changes it in Administration, Privacy & access, Users.

browser.hint: Kept only in the local storage of this browser. Nothing here changes the server.

connect.title: Connect
connect.subtitle: Give external assistants such as Kiro, Copilot or Amazon Quick access to VoC over MCP, acting with your own access.
connect.actsAsBody: A token sees exactly the projects and feedback categories you can see. It is never an administrator and is at most an editor on any project — and you can narrow it further: read-only, one project, a short lifetime.
connect.loadFailed: Could not load your MCP tokens. Try again.
connect.mcpJsonHint: Replace <YOUR_VOC_TOKEN> with a token from below. Works with Kiro, Copilot, Cowork, Amazon Quick and any MCP client that supports Streamable HTTP with a header.
connect.skillBody: A markdown skill tells an assistant what VoC is, how to connect, which tool to use when, and the safety rules. Download it with this endpoint filled in, or share the stable link.
connect.downloadFailed: Could not download the skill. Try again.
connect.newTokenTitle: Copy your token now — it will not be shown again
connect.newTokenBody: Store it like a password. If it leaks, revoke it below.

scopeHint.read: Feedback, metrics, categories, memory, company context, projects and documents.
scopeHint.write: Also create and update project documents.
scopeHint.writeAdmin: As an administrator, this token can also run autonomous agents.

connect.nameHint: So you recognise it later, e.g. the assistant it is for.
connect.projectHint: Optional: confine project tools to one project.
connect.mintFailed: Could not create the token. Check the fields and try again.
connect.tokensEmpty: You have no MCP tokens yet.
connect.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the token. Try again.
connect.revokeBody: “{{name}}” stops working immediately for every assistant using it. This cannot be undone.
connect.mintInWorkspace: The new token will act in the {{workspace}} workspace only.
connect.mintDeploymentWide: The new token will act across the whole deployment, outside any workspace.
connect.mintNotAMember: You are not a member of this workspace, so a token cannot act here. Open the workspace from your list and add yourself as a member first, then create the token again.
connect.shortcutTitle: Connect an external assistant to this project

mcpFile.claudeCode: Save as .mcp.json in the project root.
mcpFile.cursor: Save as .cursor/mcp.json in the project, or ~/.cursor/mcp.json for every project.
mcpFile.kiro: Save as .kiro/settings/mcp.json in the workspace, or ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json. In the Kiro IDE, add VOC_MCP_TOKEN to the Mcp Approved Env Vars setting; Kiro CLI reads it from the shell.
mcpFile.inline: For clients that cannot read environment variables: the token is pasted into the file, so do not commit or share it.

connect.mcpEnvHint: This file reads the token from the {{name}} environment variable, so it holds no secret. Set it in the shell that starts the client, with a token from below:

oauth.title: Sign in with your account
oauth.body: These assistants connect with no token: add the server, and the assistant opens your browser to sign in and approve its access. It acts as you, never as an administrator.
oauth.consentHint: On the approval screen you choose read only or read and write, and optionally one project. You sign in once more on the account page that follows.
oauth.webUntested: Web assistants can sign in with the same server URL. Their sign-in has not been tested live yet.
oauth.webNotConfigured: Web assistants are not set up on this deployment (an operator adds their callback URLs).
oauth.grantsFailed: Could not load your signed-in assistants.
oauth.grantsEmpty: No assistant has signed in with your account yet.
oauth.revokeBody: “{{name}}” loses access at its next request and has to sign in and be approved again.
oauth.mintingOff: Personal tokens cannot be created on this deployment. Existing tokens keep working until they expire or are revoked; sign in with your account instead.

feedbackDimension.label: Feedback type
feedbackDimension.description: What kind of feedback a review is: one primary type, set by the model for every source.

feedbackTypeDescriptions.bug: Something is broken or wrong: an error, a crash, wrong data
feedbackTypeDescriptions.service_failure: The service did not deliver: an outage, a failed delivery or payment, cannot log in
feedbackTypeDescriptions.feature_request: Asks for something new or for a change
feedbackTypeDescriptions.usability: Works, but is confusing or hard to use
feedbackTypeDescriptions.performance: Works, but is slow (a crash is a bug)
feedbackTypeDescriptions.support_experience: How customer support or staff handled the customer
feedbackTypeDescriptions.praise: Positive feedback with no problem to fix
feedbackTypeDescriptions.question: Asks how something works

oauthConsent.title: Approve an assistant
oauthConsent.asks: {{client}} asks to use VoC as you.
oauthConsent.inWorkspace: This sign-in will act in the {{workspace}} workspace only.
oauthConsent.deploymentWide: This sign-in will act outside any workspace, across this deployment.

scope.read: Read only: search feedback, metrics, memory and projects
scope.write: Read and write: also create and update documents

oauthConsent.actsAs: It gets your access to projects and categories, at most as an editor, never as an administrator. You can sign it out on the Connect page at any time.
oauthConsent.runsAgents: As an administrator, you also let it start agent runs (checked again on every run).
oauthConsent.notAMember: You are not a member of this workspace, so the sign-in cannot act here. Open the workspace from your list and add yourself as a member first, then approve again.
oauthConsent.invalid: This sign-in request is not valid. Start the sign-in again from your assistant.
oauthConsent.refused: The assistant’s request cannot be approved: {{reason}}

reviewTypeFilter.label: Review types
reviewTypeFilter.problemsOnlyHint: Bugs, service failures, performance, usability, pricing and billing, and support experience. Feature requests, praise, questions and other reviews are hidden.
reviewTypeFilter.untyped: Reviews not typed yet: {{n, number}} (kept in view)
reviewTypeFilter.untypedHint: Reviews stored before review types existed have no type until an administrator classifies them in Administration → Taxonomy. They stay in view under every type filter.
